extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants and recipients (PIs, senior/key personnel, and administrative staff preparing application attachments)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing NIH biographical sketch (biosketch) attachments for proposed senior/key personnel and other significant contributors on grant applications, progress reports, and personnel-change requests, following NIH-required format and use of available tools/samples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: A biographical sketch (also referred to as biosketch) documents an individual's qualifications and experience for a specific role in a project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NIH staff and peer reviewers utilize the biosketch to ensure that individuals included on the applications are equipped with the skills, knowledge, and resources necessary to carry out the proposed research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who must submit a biosketch
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH requires submission of a biosketch for each proposed senior/key personnel and other significant contributor on a grant application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some funding opportunities or programs may also request biosketches for additional personnel (e.g., Participating Faculty Biosketch attachment for institutional training awards).

rubrics_metrics.name: When biosketches are required
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants and recipients are required to submit biosketches: (1) in competing applications for all types of grant programs; (2) in progress reports when new senior/key personnel or other significant contributors are identified; and (3) to support prior approval requests for changes in senior/key personnel status and changes of recipient organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conformance to specific NIH format
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH biosketches must conform to a specific format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and recipients can use the provided format pages to prepare their biosketch attachments or can use SciENcv, a tool used to develop and automatically format biosketches according to NIH requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Available format pages, samples, and FAQs
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH provides specific format pages and sample attachments for different biosketch contexts (e.g., Biosketch (Non-Fellowship), Biosketch (Fellowship)) and an FAQs section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided format pages and sample documents as authoritative templates; consult the FAQs and linked resources (SciENcv, Format Attachments guidance) for technical and formatting questions.
